create-contact.name: create-contact
create-contact.description: Create a new contact in ConnectUC

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

user.description: Select the user who owns this contact

first_name.description: The first name of the contact

last_name.description: The last name of the contact

email.description: The email address of the contact

phones.description: The phone numbers of the contact

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact in a ConnectUC user's address book under the given domain and subscriber. Use when an agent needs to add a person (name, phone numbers, optional email, company, and tags) to a user's contacts. Not idempotent: each call adds another contact record, so calling it repeatedly with the same input creates duplicates.

do-not-disturb.name: do-not-disturb
do-not-disturb.description: Enable or disable Do Not Disturb status for a user in ConnectUC

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

user.description: Select the user who owns this contact

dnd.description: Enable or disable Do Not Disturb status

aiMetadata.description: Sets a ConnectUC user's Do Not Disturb (DND) state to on or off via the DND checkbox, for the given domain and subscriber. Use when an agent needs to silence or re-enable a user's incoming calls. Idempotent: it sets DND to an absolute on/off value, so repeating the same call leaves the user in the same final state.

find-cdr.name: find-cdr
find-cdr.description: Find a Call Detail Record (CDR) by original call ID

origCallid.description: The original call ID (origCallid) to search for

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single Call Detail Record (CDR) for the authenticated user by its original call ID (origCallid). Use when an agent has a call ID and needs that call's details, such as before updating its notes. Idempotent: it is a read-only lookup that does not modify anything.

initiate-call.name: initiate-call
initiate-call.description: Initiate an outbound call from a ConnectUC extension

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

user.description: Select the user who owns this contact

device.description: Select the device to use for the call

toNumber.description: The destination number of the call

aiMetadata.description: Places an outbound (click-to-call) phone call from a specific ConnectUC device/extension to a destination number, under the given domain and subscriber. Use when an agent needs to ring a user's device and connect it to a phone number. Not idempotent: each call starts a new outbound call.

send-sms.name: send-sms
send-sms.description: Send an SMS message through ConnectUC

recipients.description: The phone number to send the SMS to

attachment_urls.description: The media attachment urls for the SMS message

aiMetadata.description: Sends an SMS/MMS text message from a ConnectUC sender number to one or more recipient phone numbers, optionally with media attachment URLs. Use when an agent needs to text a person or group. Not idempotent: each call sends a new message (a fresh reference ID is generated per call), so repeating it delivers duplicate texts.

update-cdr.name: update-cdr
update-cdr.description: Update a Call Detail Record (CDR) in ConnectUC

cdrId.description: The ID of the CDR to update

reason.description: The reason for the call outcome

aiMetadata.description: Updates the notes on an existing Call Detail Record (CDR) for the authenticated user, setting a required note plus optional disposition and reason. Use when an agent needs to annotate a known call with an outcome or comment; requires the CDR ID. Idempotent: it overwrites the same fields on the identified CDR, so repeating the call with the same input yields the same final state.

newRecording.name: newRecording
newRecording.description: Triggers when a new call recording is available

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

users.description: Select users to which this trigger applies

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new call recording becomes available for the selected ConnectUC domain and users. Represents a completed, recorded call, providing the recording metadata and download/media URLs.

newCallTranscription.name: newCallTranscription
newCallTranscription.description: Triggers when a new call transcription is created

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

users.description: Select users to which this trigger applies

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new call transcription is created for the selected ConnectUC domain and users. Represents a finished speech-to-text transcript of a call, including per-speaker timestamped comments and the linked call/CDR IDs.

newCallSummary.name: newCallSummary
newCallSummary.description: Triggers when a new call summary is created

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

users.description: Select users to which this trigger applies

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new call summary is created for the selected ConnectUC domain and users. Represents an AI/auto-generated text summary of a completed call, keyed to its call ID.

newCdr.name: newCdr
newCdr.description: Triggers when a new Call Detail Record (CDR) is created

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

users.description: Select users to which this trigger applies

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new Call Detail Record (CDR) is created for the selected ConnectUC domain and users. Represents a logged call (incoming or outgoing) with its metadata such as direction, duration, from/to numbers, and disposition.

newIncomingCall.name: newIncomingCall
newIncomingCall.description: Triggers when a new incoming call is received

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

users.description: Select users to which this trigger applies

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new inbound call arrives for the selected ConnectUC domain and users. Represents a live incoming call event with caller ID, destination, and device details; an optional status filter can scope it to ringing, answered, or both.

newOutgoingCall.name: newOutgoingCall
newOutgoingCall.description: Triggers when a new outgoing call is initiated

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

users.description: Select users to which this trigger applies

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new outbound call is initiated for the selected ConnectUC domain and users. Represents a live outgoing call event with the originating extension/device, destination number, and call IDs.

newVoicemail.name: newVoicemail
newVoicemail.description: Triggers when a new voicemail is received

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

users.description: Select users to which this trigger applies

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new voicemail is received for the selected ConnectUC domain and users. Represents a deposited voicemail message with its metadata, audio file reference, and optional transcription.

newSms.name: newSms
newSms.description: Triggers when a new SMS message is received or sent

domain.description: Select domain to which this trigger applies

users.description: Select the user to which this trigger applies

recipients.description: Select the SMS recipient numbers to which this trigger applies

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new SMS/MMS message is sent or received (configurable via Direction) for the selected ConnectUC domain, user, and recipient numbers. Represents a text with its content, sender, recipients, direction, and any media attachments.
